thread:
katie: kicking off change window for embed-service canary v1.12.0 at 02:10 UTC. please monitor SLO dashboards and call out any anomalies
deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=embed-service, version=v1.12.0-canary, targets=10%
alex: adding release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/v1.12.0 (kv-cache improvements, shard fetch retry)
priya: dashboards up. watching eu-west embed route p95 and 5xx
jamie: seeing a 5xx blip starting 02:12 UTC — p95 rising from 0.42s -> 1.1s
maria: 5xx rate trending to 0.85% across canary hosts
ops-bot: Alert: embed-service.eu-west 5xx_rate=0.9% > 0.5% for 3m
alex: anyone seeing coincident deploy to model-store or reranker?
priya: no other deploys. traces point to model shard fetch timeouts and kv_cache_miss spikes
jamie: log tail:
```
2026-03-21T02:12:34Z embed-service pid=451 request_id=abc123 error="timeout fetching model shard" duration_ms=320
2026-03-21T02:13:01Z embed-service pid=452 request_id=def456 kv_cache_miss=true
```
katie: ops-bot, what's the user-facing impact on search-embed SLO?
ops-bot: Metric snapshot: search-embed.p95=1.08s (baseline=0.44s), error_rate=0.78% (baseline=0.12%)
alex: that's outside our canary tolerance. propose we pause rollout and pin traffic back to v1.11.9
maria: +1. this affects non-canary users. we should pin and collect artifacts
priya: ready to execute pin via rollout API on approval
jamie: agree. will gather canary pod logs and attach to incident playbook
katie: who will run the pin? alex?
alex: running pin now: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/rollouts/pin -d '{"service":"embed-service","to":"v1.11.9"}'`
deploy-bot: action=pin_traffic service=embed-service from=v1.12.0-canary to=v1.11.9 status=success
ops-bot: Notice: rollout paused, traffic pinned to v1.11.9. Canary instances scaled to zero
priya: re-checking metrics — p95 back to ~0.46s, 5xx down to 0.13%
maria: tagging eng-runtime and eng-releases for RCA and next steps
jamie: saving pod logs, core dumps, and start/stop telemetry to the incident folder
katie: annotate rollout with reason: "canary shard-timeout / kv_cache miss spike"
alex: rollout metadata updated with annotation
priya: recommend marking release blocked and removing public release notes until we re-verify\jm: (typo)
maria: scheduling short blameless triage with runtime/infrastructure in +20m. invite eng-runtime, eng-infra, eng-platform
jamie: quick hypothesis: quantization tweak might have changed shard lookup behavior or timing; will diff build flags and artifact list\katie: action items: 1) runtime to triage shard timeouts and KV interaction; 2) QA to run targeted canary tests exercising shard fetch paths; 3) release ops to coordinate next attempt and update release notes; 4) observability to add temporary debug logs for shard fetch latencies
alex: filed ticket RED-8765 "embed-service canary shard timeouts" and linked logs
deploy-bot: Audit: user=alex action=pin_traffic service=embed-service reason="canary 5xx spike" ts=1763344690
priya: also adding a lightweight pre-rollout probe for shard fetch in the canary harness before next attempt
jamie: recommend avoiding TTL hacks for now — could mask root cause. prefer adjusting fetch retry/timeouts or circuit-breaker tuning\maria: agreed. keep changes minimal for next canary and re-run with targeted probe
katie: I'll post a short summary to #release-updates when we have RCA outline. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
